items.text: What proportion of students in grades 7 to 9 in the district were up to date for HPV, meningococcal ACWY and the pertussis-containing booster on 2026-06-30, overall and by quintile of neighbourhood deprivation?
items.population: Students in grades 7 to 9 in 41 district secondary schools
items.intervention: Attending a school in a more deprived neighbourhood
items.comparator: Attending a school in the least deprived quintile
items.outcome: Up to date for all three adolescent vaccines

items.text: How did consent form return and refusal differ between schools, and between delivery by paper and by text message, during the catch-up campaign?
items.population: Consent forms sent to families of grade 7 to 9 students
items.intervention: Text message reminder with electronic form

finer: Feasible in either branch with one epidemiologist and program nurses; interesting to the district and schools; novel locally; ethical with no identifiable output; relevant to next year's plan.
summary: Two questions shared by both branches: coverage by deprivation, and consent return by school and route.
